groups.defect: Unhandled failures in both the OAuth token exchange and the user-info lookup produce HTTP 500 responses instead of the intended error page.
groups.rationale: Both report unhandled exceptions from get_user_info. s_25ae84d7 additionally reports the unprotected safe_urlopen token-exchange call, which the merged comment must preserve.

groups.defect: Direct indexing of integration.metadata["sender"]["login"] raises KeyError when sender metadata is missing.
groups.rationale: All three identify the same unchecked metadata access in the installer comparison. Their different examples and supporting evidence describe the same failure, resolved by guarding that lookup.
